entries.en: Added setting to enable/disable terminal progress bar (OSC 9;4)
entries.zh: 添加了启用/禁用终端进度条的设置（OSC 9;4）

entries.en: VSCode Extension: Added support for VS Code's secondary sidebar (VS Code 1.97+), allowing Claude Code to be displayed in the right sidebar while keeping the file explorer on the left. Requires setting sidebar as Preferred Location in the config.
entries.zh: VS Code 扩展：支持 VS Code 的次级侧边栏（VS Code 1.97+），可在右侧边栏显示 Claude Code，同时左侧保留文件浏览器。需要在配置中将侧边栏设为首选位置
